instruction: Show how to add a dark mode toggle that respects the user's system preference initially.
response:
```artifact-html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Prefers‑Color‑Scheme Dark Mode</title>
<style>
  body { transition:background .3s, color .3s; }
  .dark { background:#000; color:#fff; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button id="dm">Toggle Dark</button>
<script>
  if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
    document.body.classList.add('dark');
  }
  document.getElementById('dm').onclick = () => document.body.classList.toggle('dark');
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

instruction: Create a simple HTML page with a drawing canvas where the user can draw freehand lines using the mouse.
response:
```artifact-html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<meta charset='UTF-8'>
<title>Simple Canvas</title>
<style>
canvas{border:1px solid #000;cursor:crosshair;}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id='c' width='400' height='300'></canvas>
<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d');
let drawing=false;
c.onmousedown=e=>{drawing=true;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(e.offsetX,e.offsetY);};
c.onmousemove=e=>{if(!drawing)return;ctx.lineTo(e.offsetX,e.offsetY);ctx.stroke();};
c.onmouseup=c.onmouseleave=()=>drawing=false;
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

<script>
const c=document.getElementById('c'),ctx=c.getContext('2d'),save=document.getElementById('save');
let drawing=false;
c.onmousedown=e=>{drawing=true;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(e.offsetX,e.offsetY);};
c.onmousemove=e=>{if(!drawing)return;ctx.lineTo(e.offsetX,e.offsetY);ctx.stroke();};
c.onmouseup=c.onmouseleave=()=>drawing=false;
save.onclick=()=>{const img=c.toDataURL('image/png');window.open(img);};
</script>
</body>
</html>
